skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature and characteristics of cruise tourism and hotel operations.
Analyze service management practices on cruise ships, including human resources, food and beverage, facilities, customer service, and safety.
Apply strategic planning principles to cruise operations, including itinerary design and logistics.
Understand maritime laws and regulations, and their impact on cruise operations.
Analyze geographical and logistical factors in cruise itinerary planning.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and solve real-world cruise management problems.
Develop and deliver effective presentations on cruise management topics.
Work effectively in teams to develop and present cruise management solutions.
Communicate effectively in both written and oral formats.
Identify and solve problems related to cruise management.
